blocks.text: Coriander defies death itself with this mi-ra-cu-lous potion!
blocks.translation: [ru] Coriander defies death itself with this mi-ra-cu-lous potion!

blocks.text: ...but please, save your applause, people of Komona!
blocks.translation: [ru] ...but please, save your applause, people of Komona!

blocks.text: The real potion you've al been waiting for: the one which will amaze your neighbors...
blocks.translation: [ru] The real potion you've al been waiting for: the one which will amaze your neighbors...

blocks.text: ...all this is possible with the simple application of a single drop of my...

blocks.text: Fantastic! Incredible! This potion could make all of Komona rich!
blocks.translation: [ru] Fantastic! Incredible! This potion could make all of Komona rich!

blocks.text: Your applause can't be wrong. Coriander has already been eliminated.
